title: Pan-Seared Trout Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic tagine dish made with pan-seared trout and kissed spice blend.
instructions: Season the trout fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the light olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced rainbow bell peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the trout fillets to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the trout is cooked through.
While the trout is cooking, mix together the kissed spice blend and a pinch of salt.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the spice blend over the trout.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
